paras.text: To build a water filtration apparatus.
paras.urdu: پانی چھاننے کا آلہ بنانا۔
paras.pashto: د اوبو د فلټر وسیله جوړول.

paras.text: Take a soft drink plastic bottle, cut it in the middle leaving the lower part a little longer than the upper one. The upper part will be used as funnel and the lower part as receiving part. Put some cotton at the mouth of the bottle as a plug and some sand above the cotton plug. (the sand must be washed and dried beforehand so as to remove any dust or water-soluble substances). Put this funnel in the receiving part and add some muddy water slowly in it. You will see the filtered water as clean and transparent as the fresh water.
paras.urdu: سافٹ ڈرنک کی پلاسٹک کی بوتل لیں، اسے درمیان سے کاٹیں اور نچلا حصہ اوپری حصے سے تھوڑا لمبا رکھیں۔ اوپری حصہ قیف اور نچلا حصہ وصول کرنے والے حصے کے طور پر استعمال ہوگا۔ بوتل کے منہ پر ڈاٹ کے طور پر کچھ روئی اور روئی کے ڈاٹ کے اوپر کچھ ریت رکھیں۔ (ریت کو پہلے سے دھو کر خشک کر لیں تاکہ کوئی گرد یا پانی میں حل پذیر مادہ نکل جائے)۔ اس قیف کو وصول کرنے والے حصے میں رکھیں اور اس میں آہستہ آہستہ کچھ گدلا پانی ڈالیں۔ آپ دیکھیں گے کہ چھنا ہوا پانی تازہ پانی کی طرح صاف اور شفاف ہے۔
paras.pashto: د نرم څښاک یو پلاستیکي بوتل واخلئ، له منځه یې پرې کړئ او ښکته برخه له پورتنۍ لږ اوږده پرېږدئ. پورتنۍ برخه به د قیف او ښکته برخه به د اخیستونکې برخې په توګه وکارول شي. د بوتل په خوله کې د بندوونکي په توګه لږ مالوچ او د مالوچو د بندوونکي پر سر لږ شګه کېږدئ. (شګه باید مخکې ومینځل او وچه شي څو هره دوړه یا په اوبو کې حلېدونکي مواد لرې شي). دا قیف په اخیستونکې برخه کې کېږدئ او ورو ورو لږ خړې اوبه ورته واچوئ. تاسو به فلټر شوې اوبه د تازه اوبو په څېر پاکې او روڼې وګورئ.

Project

To build a water filtration apparatus.

Take a soft drink plastic bottle, cut it in the middle leaving the lower part a little longer than the upper one. The upper part will be used as funnel and the lower part as receiving part. Put some cotton at the mouth of the bottle as a plug and some sand above the cotton plug. (the sand must be washed and dried beforehand so as to remove any dust or water-soluble substances). Put this funnel in the receiving part and add some muddy water slowly in it. You will see the filtered water as clean and transparent as the fresh water.

sections.content:
11. In which of the following layer of atmosphere there is more thickness of the ozone layer?

a. Troposphere b. Stratosphere c. Mesosphere d. Thermosphere

12. Which of the following is more dangerous for the ozone layer?

a. CFCs b. CO₂ c. CO d. Oxides of nitrogen

13. Which of the following factors help to measure the quality of water?

a. DO b. BOD c. COD d. All of the above

14. In the purification of water the flocculating agent used is

a. alum. b. nickel sulphate. c. copper sulphate. d. barium sulphate.

15. The basic principle of green chemistry is/are

a. to prevent waste creation. b. to maximize the atom economy. c. to create less hazardous synthetic chemicals. d. all of the above.

Q2. Write short answers of the following questions.

i. Why is acid rain considered as a threat to historical monuments?

ii. Define the following: a. Contaminants b. Pollutant c. Acid rain d. Biological oxygen demand (BOD) e. Smog

iii. What is importance of dissolved oxygen in water?

iv. How we can reduce pollution due to SO₂?

v. Write any four principles of Green Chemistry.

vi. Name four major greenhouse gases.

vii. Out of CFCs and CO₂ which one has higher potential to cause global warming and why?

viii. Why does the rain water normally have pH of about 5.6 and when does it change into acid rain?

ix. Which gases are converted to harmless gases by 3-way catalytic converter?

Q3. Write detail answers of the following questions.

1. (i) ‘Green Chemistry is a new route to the protection of environment’. Comment on it.

(ii) What is greenhouse effect? How is it causing global warming?

2. (i) What is meant by atmosphere? Explain the various layers of atmosphere.

(ii) Define air pollution and discuss its effects.

3. (i) What is role of ozone layer in upper atmosphere?

(ii) What will happen if ozone is no more present in upper atmosphere?

4. What is water pollution? What are the main sources of water pollution?

5. Write note on the following. (a) Acid rain (b) Smog (c) Water treatment (d) Chemistry of stratosphere

Project

To build a water filtration apparatus.

Take a soft drink plastic bottle, cut it in the middle leaving the lower part a little longer than the upper one. The upper part will be used as funnel and the lower part as receiving part. Put some cotton at the mouth of the bottle as a plug and some sand above the cotton plug. (the sand must be washed and dried beforehand so as to remove any dust or water-soluble substances). Put this funnel in the receiving part and add some muddy water slowly in it. You will see the filtered water as clean and transparent as the fresh water.
